instruction: Candid black and white documentary photograph, full shot at eye-level. On an outdoor paved embankment under an overcast sky, the bearded man in the grey overcoat (R1) and the woman in the black coat and cap (R2) are playfully dancing. Positioned on the right, the smiling bearded man (R1) holds his partner's hand high in the air. On the left, the woman (R2) spins around with her back partially turned to the camera. Their hands are clasped together at the peak of her turn. The scene is captured in a monochrome palette with soft, diffused daylight and no bystanders.
